top_signals.title: Palo Alto Networks warns of Fragnesia flaw exploited in PAN-OS attacks
top_signals.summary: Threat actors are chaining exploits for the PHP2Shell and Fragnesia vulnerabilities to target Palo Alto Networks devices with management interfaces exposed to the internet. [...]
